import os, subprocess, sys, time, signal, tempfile, shutil
big = "~/Developer/Perso/happier/apps/ui/node_modules"
S = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="p0kl.", dir=os.environ.get("TMPDIR", "/tmp"))
def count(p):
    n = 0
    for _, _, fs in os.walk(p): n += len(fs)
    return n
code = ("import ctypes,ctypes.util,sys,time\n"
        "l=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('c'),use_errno=True)\n"
        "l.clonefile.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_uint32]\n"
        "t=time.time()\n"
        "rc=l.clonefile(sys.argv[1].encode(),sys.argv[2].encode(),1)\n"
        "print('rc',rc,'took',round(time.time()-t,2),flush=True)\n")
for i, delay in enumerate((0.3, 1.0, 2.0)):
    dst = f"{S}/d{i}"
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", code, big, dst], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    time.sleep(delay)
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGKILL); p.wait(); time.sleep(0.3)
    ex = os.path.exists(dst)
    print(f"kill at {delay}s: exit={p.returncode} dst exists={ex} files={count(dst) if ex else 0}", flush=True)
# full clone time for reference now that the cache is warm
dst = f"{S}/full"
t = time.time(); p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, big, dst], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("full:", p.stdout.strip(), "files", count(dst))
shutil.rmtree(S, ignore_errors=True); print("cleaned", not os.path.exists(S))
EOF
